system.description:
Your [Initiative] will be 0 until the end of the round. From your line of sight, designate Sq of [Target: Wide (SRx 2)] (A) / Range: 4 Sq] as the target. If you do a [Magic Attack] in the first main process of this round with [Target: Area], the target of that attack is changed to [existing in all Sq specified as target (indiscriminate)].

A special skill that draws a three-dimensional magic formation by accumulating magical power around it while chanting. Dramatically increases the area of ​​effect of magic, but fine control becomes impossible.
